name: Marble Peacock

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), chapter 12: the 2025 Basilisk's numbers with the type changed to Construct. The words are ours. Departure (Ashwin's plan): everything its gaze turned to stone is freed when the peacock crumbles. Petrifying Gaze's second-failure Petrified stage is a rider the engine does not run yet (the first stage, Restrained, does).

traits.name: Stone Dies With It
traits.summary: Anyone its gaze turned to stone becomes flesh again the moment the peacock is destroyed.
traits.text: If the marble peacock is reduced to 0 Hit Points, every creature its Petrifying Gaze turned to stone is freed and is no longer Petrified or Restrained by it.

actions.name: Bite
actions.summary: A snapping marble beak with a venomous sting in it.

bonus_actions.name: Petrifying Gaze

params.when: end of the target's next turn if it is still Restrained

bonus_actions.summary: Recharge 4-6. A 30-ft cone: DC 12 Con save or Restrained; a second failed save turns the target to stone until the peacock crumbles.
bonus_actions.text: Constitution saving throw, DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the basilisk can see its own reflection in the Cone, it must make the save too. First failure: Restrained, with a repeat save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on a success. Second failure: Petrified instead of Restrained.

summary: An oversized albino peacock carved in marble, with one bloodstone eye, whose gaze roots a victim in place and then turns it to stone. Its stone is undone when it crumbles.
